1. Get your order report from Seller Central
In Seller Central open Reports, then Order Reports (menu names can differ a little by country).
Open "Add or remove order report columns" and switch on "Buyer tax identifiers" and "Buyer company name". Save.
Request the report for the dates you need and download it as a tab-delimited text file.

We checked these column names against Amazon's developer documentation. We have not yet tested them on a real downloaded file, so if your file is not accepted, tell us what the first line looks like.

2. Upload it
Drop your order report here
or choose the file on your phone or computer
Choose file
 My report has no billing address. Use the delivery address instead, and I accept that it is the right one for my invoices.
